# Retained format references

These Python reference files were retained from the HCM animation-format investigation (reference revision `d8061ad4`). They describe Bitsquid/Stingray serialized animation structures and are provided under the accompanying GNU GPL v3 license. They are not imported by the game mod or packaged in the install ZIP.

`../inspect_controllers.py` and the rebuild tools use their own bounded reader. No Blender runtime or these reference modules is needed to run the condition collection.
